description: Create a Folder in a Space from a Folder template, reproducing the template's Lists, statuses and structure. Returns the created Folder. Use to spin up a standardized project layout.

options.description: Optional template import options, e.g. { return_immediately: true, content: {...} }.

space_id.description: ID of the Space to create the Folder in.

template_id.description: ID of the Folder template to instantiate.

name: create_folder_from_template
